_meta.purpose: Test fixture for the final stage of the pipeline: the render-ready shape a generated resume must take, and the input contract for the JSON-to-TeX renderer. Unlike data/master_resume.json, this file DOES contain finished bullet prose - it is the output, not the data lake.
_meta.captured_from: ../Resume/resume.tex, the hand-written base resume, as of 2026-10-04
_meta.fidelity: Content follows the base resume so that a format-parity test is meaningful. Unambiguous typographic defects in the base are corrected here (see fixed_from_base); substantive content errors are reproduced and logged (see deviations_from_master). This is NOT a correct resume and must not be used as expected generator output.
fixed_from_base: Heading separators normalised: a uniform ' \quad' between contacts, with none trailing after the last
Phone restored to '+1 217 305 1018'; the base dropped the country code
Project title 'Random Forest Classifier' -> 'Classifiers', matching the published paper title
Degree 'Master of Computer Science in Computer Science and Engineering' -> 'Master of Computer Science'; the base phrase is doubled

deviations_from_master.issue: The Aug 2022 - Jan 2023 entry is labelled Epsilon Pvt Ltd but carries Epsilon's content under Intel's dates. Per data/master_resume.json, Epsilon ran 2022-01 to 2022-06 and Intel ran 2022-08 to 2023-01.
The Intel Solutions & Services India internship is missing entirely. Three employers exist; two are shown.

Qualcomm shown as a single Software Engineer role. The master records Associate Engineer 2023-01 to 2024-12, then Software Engineer from 2025-01. Collapsing is permitted by presentation_preferences.qualcomm_titles, so this is acceptable rendering rather than an error.
Publications are reduced to a venue plus a Paper Link. No author lists, volumes, pages or DOIs, and first authorship on the Springer chapter is not shown.
'achieving mAP values of 84.36% and 80.92%' does not bind each figure to its model. The master binds YOLOv5 to 84.36% and DETR to 80.92%.
No achievements section, matching presentation_preferences.achievements_section (drops first) and the base having it commented out.
